blocks.text: Alpöge 是斯坦福大学的数学家，他于 2026 年 11 月 20 日以 1700 万行 Lean 代码的形式公布了这一证明。Lean 是一款用于检查数学证明中错误的工具。数十人独立运行了这些代码，得到了相同的结果。这些验证程序的设计使其可证明地无法接受有缺陷的证明。麻省理工学院数学家 Andrew Sutherland 在其网站上列出了各项独立验证。

blocks.text: The Lean and Mathlib community has confirmed that Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct. "We have full confidence that Alpöge's proof is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement," the community said in a statement.

blocks.text: Alpöge, a Stanford mathematician, published the proof on Nov. 20, 2026, as 17 million lines of code written in Lean, a tool that checks mathematical proofs for errors. Dozens of people ran the code independently and got the same result. The verification programs are designed so they provably cannot accept a flawed proof. MIT mathematician Andrew Sutherland lists the independent checks on his website.

blocks.text: The solution arrived much earlier than expected. As Ethan Mollick notes, forecasters on Metaculus had put the expected date at May 2035. Mathematician Terence Tao said last month he expected the problem to fall to "a combination of humans and AI around 2050 or so."
